courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Pioneering Spirit 工程船
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以浮體排水與質量建立起點，接到繫線路徑與幾何長度的系統介面，最後用線性模型與海況適用範圍整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Float displacement and mass, connect through Mooring route and geometric length, then integrate evidence using Linear-model and sea-state scope. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 浮式平台繫泊系統
history.text: 本專題以浮體排水與質量建立起點，接到繫線路徑與幾何長度的系統介面，最後用線性模型與海況適用範圍整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Float displacement and mass, connect through Mooring route and geometric length, then integrate evidence using Linear-model and sea-state scope. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 用小位移繫泊模型比較復原力、固有週期與疲勞，並標示鬆索及大位移非線性。 在浮式平台繫泊模型室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Compare restoring force, period and fatigue in a small-offset mooring model while marking slack-line and large-offset nonlinearities. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Floating-platform mooring model laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
